name: He Xiang Lian Lu
source:
The story describes a newly graduated college student who is at lost about his future. To find himself, he had decided to go on a journey in Izumi, not only finding "love across Izumi" but also the meaning of life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1189850/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一名刚毕业的大学生对自己的未来感到迷茫的故事。为了寻找自我，他决定踏上和泉之旅，不仅寻找“跨越和泉的爱”，也寻找生命的意义。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1189850/]Steam[/url]]
